claims.text: Tác phẩm có thật, tên: Khảo luận về bản tính con người (A Treatise of Human Nature)

sources.quote: A Treatise of Human Nature, 1739–40, D.F. Norton and M.J. Norton (eds.)
he began writing A Treatise of Human Nature
Books 1 and 2 of the Treatise were published anonymously in 1739, with Book 3 (as well as a similarly anonymous “Abstract” of the first two books) following a year later in 1740
